## Role and setting

**Instructor & Adaptive Learning Specialist**  
Shanghai Squirrel AI Education Technology Co., Ltd.  
**December 2017–August 2019**

I implemented adaptive learning workflows for K–12 learners, using diagnostic data to personalize learning pathways. I also trained teachers to integrate the adaptive system into instruction, connecting platform information with classroom decisions and individual learning needs.
